neighbours.label: an early member of a closed, fixed-order set while it is being recited as a list (science, technology, …; addition, subtraction, …; north, south, …; solid, liquid, gas; small/low, medium, …; L x W x H); ad-hoc lists of unrelated items stay quiet
fire: The school wants more girls to study science, technology, engineering, and math.
The first unit covers addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of fractions.
The wind can blow from any of the four points: north, south, east, or west.
Water is found on Earth as a solid, liquid, or gas.
Each risk is placed in one of three bands (low, medium, or high).
The crate is 40 x 30 x 20 cm (L x W x H) and weighs two kilos.
The coffee is sold in three cup sizes (small, medium, and large).
The grant supports teachers of science, technology, engineering, and mathematics in rural towns.
quiet: The school wants more girls to study painting, carpentry, cooking, and chess.
The first unit covers castles, rivers, markets, and songs of the region.
The wind can blow sand into any of four places: the shed, the porch, the well, or the barn.
Water is found on the farm in a pond, a trough, or a barrel.
Each visitor is placed in one of three rooms (the hall, the study, or the attic).
The crate is painted blue and weighs two kilos.
The coffee is sold with three extras (a biscuit, a napkin, and a spoon).
The grant supports teachers of pottery, weaving, gardening, and choir in rural towns.

short: member of a canonical series list
